name: cavemio-booking
title: Booking
description: Book a call on one card: the time you pick prints onto the host’s ticket, then the times turn into your details and the confirmation.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Days and times are radio groups with arrow keys (up and down move a row of times), Home and End; each face is a labelled group that takes focus when the surface turns to it, and Escape goes back from your details.
- The printed time is read as a whole ("Tuesday, October 28, 10:30 AM") from sr-only text, never digit by digit; Booked and Cancelled are announced from a status region beside the card.
- Field errors are tied to their fields and shake once; a refused booking is an alert under the button and keeps everything typed.
- Today and the visitor’s time zone are read once mounted, so the server render never shows a wrong day.
- Its light comes from your theme: the ticket mixes --primary-foreground into --primary for the lit corner, 1px light edges and the perforation, and the notches are cut by a mask, so it follows your brand in light and dark. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Input, Textarea, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library and no date library; with reduced motion the faces crossfade in place and nothing slides.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: host
props.description: – · Who the call is with, on the ticket. Initials when there’s no photo.

props.name: title / description
props.description: – · What’s being booked, on the ticket.

props.name: duration
props.description: – · Minutes; sets the end time on the stub and in the booking.

props.name: location
props.description: – · Where it happens, e.g. "Google Meet"; goes into the calendar file too.

props.name: getSlots
props.type: ({ from, to, timeZone }, signal) => Promise<(Date | string | number)[]>
props.description: – · Free start times from from up to to (a week). Called once per week shown and aborted if the visitor moves on; throw to show Try again.

props.name: onBook
props.description: – · Gets { start, end, timeZone, name, email, note }. Make the booking; resolve with { id?, meetingUrl? }, throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: – · Shows Cancel booking once booked; gets the request with your id. Throw to keep the booking and say why.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: the visitor’s · IANA zone to show and group times in.

props.name: locale / hour12
props.description: browser / the locale’s · Formats days and times with Intl.

props.name: defaultDate
props.description: today · A day in the first week shown.

useCases.title: Consultations

useCases.title: Appointments

useCases.title: Onboarding calls

features.title: Times in the visitor’s zone
features.description: Days and times are worked out in their time zone (or yours, with timeZone), clock changes included, and the zone is printed on the ticket.

features.title: One request per week
features.description: getSlots gets the week on screen, is aborted if you move on first, and the week is kept until a booking or cancel changes it.

features.title: The time prints on the ticket
features.description: Picking a time rolls it onto the stub and the date morphs, so what you are booking is never in doubt.

features.title: Details on the same surface
features.description: The times turn into name, email and a note; missing or wrong fields shake and say why.

features.title: Taken while you typed
features.description: If onBook throws, its message shows under Try again and the week is fetched again, so the taken time is gone when you go back.

features.title: A confirmation that does things
features.description: Add to calendar downloads a real .ics, Google Calendar opens prefilled, the meeting link is there, and onCancel gives a two-step Cancel.

states.title: pick
states.description: The host’s ticket, lit from its top corner, holds the name, the call, its length and place; under a perforation with two punched notches its stub says Pick a time. Beside it a week of days (days with no times are struck through), the day’s free times and Continue.

states.title: loading
states.description: While getSlots answers, the times are quiet placeholder pills and the days wait; a week that fails says so with Try again.

states.title: printed
states.description: Picking a time prints it on the stub: the first one fades up out of a 6px blur, later ones roll their hours and minutes the way the time moved (900ms), the date morphs, and a ring is thrown to the time you picked.

states.title: week / day
states.description: The arrows page by week; the new week and a new day’s times come in from the side you moved to (420ms), and the day highlight is thrown across.

states.title: details
states.description: Continue turns the times into Name, Email and a note in 460ms (the times slide left through a blur, the form comes in from the right, the height eases).

states.title: booking
states.description: Book morphs to Booking with a spinner; fields and Back are locked until it settles.

states.title: booked
states.description: A check draws itself in the button, the surface turns to the confirmation, the stub reads Confirmed and a check stamps onto it (a 0.6 → 1 throw, then the stroke draws).

states.title: taken
states.description: If onBook throws, the button shakes into Try again, your message replaces the hint, and the week is asked for again so going back shows what is really free.

states.title: cancel
states.description: Cancel booking asks once (Yes, cancel it, which goes back after 4s), then Cancelling → Cancelled, and the surface turns back to the times.
